notes.title: Hotfix v5 loading population issue
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that reduced the number of available populations to 0 when loading the game.
Fixed an item deletion bug when loading the game.
Fixed visual bugs of the item collection icons on the building.

notes.title: Hotfix v4 bronze ore, diamond craft, coal ore quantity
notes.notes:
Fixed Bronze ore gathering issue.
Fixed the issue where you could not craft Diamond Ingot.
Coal quantity increased from 2000 to 200000.
Fixed visual bugs.

notes.title: Hotfix v3 Storage, quest, bakery
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue of extra storage capacity increase when loading.
Fixed quests not showing up when loading.
Fixed an issue where the current quest was not accepted when loading.
Fixed the issue with not being able to do 10x and 100x when cooking.
Fixed several visual bugs.

notes.title: Hotfix v2 Visual bug and some fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed misinformation when hovering Storage.
Fixed bug related to storage level.
Miner has been reorganized to collect all mines.
All resources have been multiplied by 10.

notes.title: Hotfix - Miner , quests, storage capacity
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused the miner to not collect coal. 
Increased the duration of village score missions. 
Storage capacity has been increased. 
The initial storage limit has been increased.
